independentSourceInventory: Two stands with bases and a horizontal rail support a wheel/link above the central ball.
Left spring is anchored at the left stand. Right spring leads to a rope over the right pulley and then to an offset pin on the motor disk, not to the disk center.
The motor disk has a separate base and a visibly directed curved rotation arrow. The unnumbered ruler is below the spring/ball assembly.
No precise ruler reading, coil count, rotation speed or measured apparatus dimension is recoverable from this schematic.

findings.description: The source has a directed rotation arrow, but every inspected current product-width preview shows only an undirected arc. SVG contains the polygon, but the white filled disk circle paints above it and hides its tip. An object declaration and render pass do not make an invisible arrow instructional.
